import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis - Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top 15 Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(15)
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, ax=ax1, palette='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 15 Most Popular Dog Breeds', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
# Extract numeric part for proper ordering
age_order = ['0-Jährige', '1-Jährige', '2-Jährige', '3-Jährige', '4-Jährige', 
             '5-Jährige', '6-Jährige', '7-Jährige', '8-Jährige', '9-Jährige', 
             '10-Jährige', '11-Jährige', '12-Jährige', '13-Jährige', '14-Jährige', 
             '15-Jährige', '16-Jährige', '17-Jährige', '18-Jährige', '19-Jährige', '20-Jährige']
age_filtered = age_data[age_data.index.isin(age_order)]
age_filtered = age_filtered.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in age_filtered.index])
ax2.bar(range(len(age_filtered)), age_filtered.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Registered Dogs', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, len(age_filtered), 2))
ax2.set_xticklabels([str(i) for i in range(0, len(age_filtered), 2)])
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Dogs by District
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_data = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(district_data)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(district_data.values, labels=district_data.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 9})
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Dogs Across Zurich Districts', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Owner Age vs Dog Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
owner_dog_data = pd.crosstab(df['AlterV10Lang'], df['SexHundLang'])
# Sort by age groups
age_group_order = ['20- bis 29-Jährige', '30- bis 39-Jährige', '40- bis 49-Jährige', 
                   '50- bis 59-Jährige', '60- bis 69-Jährige', '70- bis 79-Jährige', 
                   '80-Jährige u. Ältere']
owner_dog_filtered = owner_dog_data.reindex([a for a in age_group_order if a in owner_dog_data.index])
owner_dog_filtered.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['steelblue', 'lightcoral'], 
                        edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Dog Gender', loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
